me_ch305.title: 17-229 Chapter 305: Rules and Regulations Pertaining to Traffic Movement Permits

hsm.title: Highway Safety Manual
hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.missing: MaineDOT's HSIP screening weighs 'excess crash costs' (HSIP 2025 report) but no MaineDOT safety manual found publishes unit costs per KABCO level; MaineDOT's grant BCAs use USDOT BCA Guidance values, which Maine hasn't stated as its safety-study method (research 2026-11-08). Needs the user's decision

statewide_rates.missing: MaineDOT computes critical rates per location type but publishes no statewide average-rate table (research 2026-11-08), and CrashIQ has no Maine traffic counts

screening.state_method: High Crash Location: 8 or more crashes in the most recent 3 years and Critical Rate Factor above 1.0 (MaineDOT Ch. 305, Part 6 Sec. 2 A, page 18)

spf_calibration.missing: MaineDOT screens intersections with HSM SPFs + EB in its own GIS tool (HSIP 2025 report); its calibration factors aren't published
